content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ISI Kolkata Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Postdoctoral Fellow, PA (Project Assistant), and Project Linked Personnel posts in ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Postdoctoral Fellow, PA (Project Assistant), and Project Linked Personnel.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026 is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026 by sending their applications via email.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years, with usual relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for a Postdoctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD (Completed/Thesis Submitted) in Mathematics/Computer Science/Statistics/related areas with at least two publications.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for a PA (Project Assistant) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for a PA (Project Assistant) is INR 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ISI Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an email application with a resume and essay, followed by shortlisting and an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these contractual posts is Kolkata, West Bengal, with pincode 700108.
